title: TRE 3.0 (2024) · Class 6–8 Maths & Science · Set L
subject: BPSC TRE PYQ
topic: Complete official question booklet of the BPSC Teacher Recruitment Exam 3.0 for Middle School (Class 6–8) Mathematics & Science, held on 19 July 2024. Part I Language (English 1–8, Hindi 9–30, qualifying), Part II General Studies (31–70), Part III Mathematics (71–110) and Science (111–150).
description: All 150 questions of booklet series L exactly as printed, with answers taken from the BPSC final answer key released on 30 August 2024. Every question has five options: A to C plus 'More than one of the above' and 'None of the above'. In the real exam Part I is qualifying only and the Urdu/Bengali alternatives to Hindi are omitted here. Use the timer for a full 2 hour 30 minute mock, or switch it off to practise section by section.

questions.question:
[Part I · English Language · Q.E-1]
Directions (Q. Nos. E-1 to E-5): Read the passage given below and answer the questions that follow.

Be like a flower. One must try to become like a flower: open, frank, equal, generous and kind. So you know what it means? A flower is open to all that surrounds it: nature, light, the rays of the sun, the wind etc. It exerts a spontaneous influence on all that is around it. It radiates joy and beauty. It is frank. It hides nothing of its beauty, lets its fragrance flow frankly out of itself. What is within and what is in its depths, it lets it come out so that everyone can see it. It is equal: it has no preferences. Everyone can enjoy its beauty and its perfume without rivalry. It is equal and the same for everybody. There is no difference or anything whatsoever. Then generous without reserve or restriction, it gives away the mysterious beauty and the very own perfume of nature. It sacrifices itself entirely for our pleasure, even its life sacrifices to express this beauty and the secret of the things gathered within itself. And then, kind: it has such a tenderness, it is so sweet, so close to us, so loving. Its presence fills us with joy. It is always cheerful and happy. Happy is he who can exchange his qualities with real qualities of the flowers.

A flower is open to all because
options: It spreads its beauty to all
More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): D.

questions.question:
[Part I · Hindi Language · Q.H-9]
निर्देश (प्रश्न संख्या H-9 से H-13 तक): निम्नलिखित गद्यांश को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और दिए गए प्रश्नों के सही विकल्प चुनिए।

गद्यांश-1: आदर्श व्यक्ति सद्कर्मों में आस्था रखता है। इसी में वह अपने जीवन की सार्थकता समझता है। उसके जीवन का प्रत्येक क्षण सद्कर्मों में ही व्यतीत होता है। विश्राम और विनोद के लिए उसके पास निश्चित समय रहता है। वह शेष समय समाज के उत्थान में लगाता है। उसके जीवन में आलस्य के लिए कोई स्थान नहीं होता। विपत्तियों में भी वह अपने चरित्र का सच्चा परिचय देता है। धैर्यरूपी कुदाल से वह बड़े-बड़े संकटरूपी पर्वतों को निर्मूल कर देता है। उसकी कार्यकुशलता देखकर लोग आश्चर्यविमूढ़ हो जाते हैं। वह परिस्थितियों का दास नहीं होता, परिस्थितियाँ उसकी दासी होती हैं। इस अर्थ में उसका चरित्र प्रशंसनीय होता है कि वह धैर्य से अपने सारे संकट दूर करता है।

किस अर्थ में आदर्श व्यक्ति का चरित्र प्रशंसनीय होता है?
options: वह बहादुरी से संकटों का सामना करता है
वह ज्ञान से संकट को दूर करता है
वह धैर्य से संकट को दूर करता है
उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): C.

questions.question:
[Part I · Hindi Language · Q.H-14]
निर्देश (प्रश्न संख्या H-14 से H-18 तक): निम्नलिखित गद्यांश को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और दिए गए प्रश्नों के सही विकल्प चुनिए।

गद्यांश-2: स्वास्थ्य और चरित्र एक-दूसरे से घनिष्ठता के साथ जुड़े होते हैं। वही व्यक्ति स्वस्थ होता है जिसके चरित्र में आत्मसंयम हो। चारित्रिक दूषण व्यक्ति के पतन का कारण होता है। आत्मसंयम को चरित्र की सीढ़ी कहा गया है। इसी सीढ़ी के माध्यम से कोई व्यक्ति उत्तरोत्तर विकास की यात्रा तय करता है। व्यायाम को स्वास्थ्य का सहोदर कहा गया है। यही किसी व्यक्ति की काया और चित्त को निर्मल और नीरुज (रोगरहित) बनाता है। चरित्र की रक्षा का अर्थ है – काया और चित्त को विभिन्न दूषणों से मुक्त करना।

स्वास्थ्य का सहोदर है
options: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): A.

निर्देश (प्रश्न संख्या H-14 से H-18 तक): निम्नलिखित गद्यांश को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और दिए गए प्रश्नों के सही विकल्प चुनिए।

गद्यांश-2: स्वास्थ्य और चरित्र एक-दूसरे से घनिष्ठता के साथ जुड़े होते हैं। वही व्यक्ति स्वस्थ होता है जिसके चरित्र में आत्मसंयम हो। चारित्रिक दूषण व्यक्ति के पतन का कारण होता है। आत्मसंयम को चरित्र की सीढ़ी कहा गया है। इसी सीढ़ी के माध्यम से कोई व्यक्ति उत्तरोत्तर विकास की यात्रा तय करता है। व्यायाम को स्वास्थ्य का सहोदर कहा गया है। यही किसी व्यक्ति की काया और चित्त को निर्मल और नीरुज (रोगरहित) बनाता है। चरित्र की रक्षा का अर्थ है – काया और चित्त को विभिन्न दूषणों से मुक्त करना।

किसी व्यक्ति का विकास किस पर आश्रित है?
options: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): A.

If (1/5)^(3x) = 0.008, then the value of (0.25)^x is
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): C. (1/5)^(3x) = 0.008 = (1/5)^3, so 3x = 3 and x = 1. Then (0.25)^1 = 0.25.

questions.question:
[Part II · General Studies · Q.35]
The ratio of two numbers is 14 : 25. If the difference between them is 264, then the smaller of the two numbers is
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): A. Let the numbers be 14k and 25k. 25k – 14k = 11k = 264, so k = 24 and the smaller number is 14 × 24 = 336.

questions.question:
[Part II · General Studies · Q.36]
Which river makes boundary between India and Nepal?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): C. The Kali (Sharda / Mahakali) river forms the western boundary between Nepal and Uttarakhand, India.

questions.question:

In which year was the African Convention for the Conservation of Natural Resources held?
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): D. The African Convention on the Conservation of Nature and Natural Resources (Algiers Convention) was adopted in 1968.

questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): C.

questions.question:

What is India's position in the world on the basis of per capita water availability per year?

questions.question:
[Part II · General Studies · Q.40]
If x⁴ + y⁴ = 17 and x + y = 1, then the value of x²y² – 2xy is
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): B. x + y = 1 gives x² + y² = 1 – 2xy. Then x⁴ + y⁴ = (x² + y²)² – 2x²y² = (1 – 2xy)² – 2x²y² = 17, so 2x²y² – 4xy – 16 = 0, i.e. x²y² – 2xy = 8.

questions.question:

Who threw harmless bombs in the Central Legislative Assembly?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): B. Bhagat Singh and Batukeshwar Dutt threw the bombs on 8 April 1929; only Batukeshwar Dutt is among the options.

questions.question:

What is manganese used for?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): D. Manganese is used in dry-cell batteries (MnO₂) and also in the match and photography industries, hence 'more than one'.

questions.question:

Subramaniam and Naidu donate some money in a relief fund. The amount paid by Naidu is ₹125 more than that of Subramaniam. If the total money paid by them is ₹975, then the amount of money donated by Subramaniam is
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): B. Let Subramaniam pay x. Then x + (x + 125) = 975, so 2x = 850 and x = ₹425.

questions.question:

options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): E. The four Gaganyaan astronaut-designates are Prasanth Nair, Ajit Krishnan, Angad Pratap and Shubhanshu Shukla, so all three names listed are among them.

A room is 8 metres long, 6 metres wide and 10 metres high, then the length of the longest pole that can be placed in the room is
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): C. Longest pole = space diagonal = √(8² + 6² + 10²) = √200 = 10√2 m.

questions.question:
[Part III · Mathematics · Q.71]
Find the market price of a 5% Rs. 100 share when a person gets a dividend of Rs. 65 by investing Rs. 1,430.
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): E. A 5% share of face value ₹100 pays ₹5 per share. Dividend ₹65 means 13 shares, bought for ₹1,430, i.e. ₹110 each. 110 is not an option.

questions.question:
[Part III · Mathematics · Q.72]
A tank is made of the shape of a cylinder with a hemispherical depression at one end. The height of the cylinder is 1.45 m and radius is 30 cm. The total surface area of the tank is
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): D. BPSC keyed this as the total surface area of the cylinder: 2πr(h + r) = 2 × (22/7) × 0.3 × (1.45 + 0.3) = 3.3 m².

questions.question:
[Part III · Mathematics · Q.73]
The length of the hypotenuse of an isosceles right triangle whose one side is 4√2 cm is
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): E. Both legs are 4√2, so hypotenuse = √(32 + 32) = 8 cm, which is not an option.

questions.question:
[Part III · Mathematics · Q.74]
If one zero of the quadratic polynomial x² + 3x + k is 2, then the value of k is
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): D. Put x = 2: 4 + 6 + k = 0, so k = –10.

questions.question:
[Part III · Mathematics · Q.75]
In an equilateral triangle ABC, AD is perpendicular to BC, then which of the following is true?
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): C. AD² = AB² – (AB/2)² = 3AB²/4, so 4AD² = 3AB².

questions.question:
[Part III · Mathematics · Q.76]
If the difference between the circumference and radius of a circle is 37 cm, then using π = 22/7, the circumference of the circle is
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): D. 2πr – r = 37 gives r(44/7 – 1) = 37, so r = 7 and circumference = 44 cm.

questions.question:
[Part III · Mathematics · Q.77]
The sum of the exponents of the prime factors in the prime factorisation of 196 is
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): C. 196 = 2² × 7², sum of exponents = 4.

questions.question:
[Part III · Mathematics · Q.78]
If 11 times the 11th term of an A.P. is equal to 7 times its 7th term, then its 18th term will be
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): B. 11(a + 10d) = 7(a + 6d) gives 4a + 68d = 0, so a + 17d = 0, which is the 18th term.

questions.question:
[Part III · Mathematics · Q.79]
Sides of two similar triangles are in the ratio 4 : 9. Areas of these triangles are in the ratio
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): B. Areas of similar triangles are in the ratio of the squares of sides: 4² : 9² = 16 : 81.

questions.question:
[Part III · Mathematics · Q.80]
If (m)ⁿ = 32 where m and n are positive integers, then the value of (n)^(mn) is
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): C. 32 = 2⁵, so m = 2, n = 5 and n^(mn) = 5^10.

questions.question:
[Part III · Mathematics · Q.81]
In a cricket match, a batsman hits the boundary 8 times out of 40 balls he plays. Find the probability that he did not hit the boundary.
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): A. Balls without a boundary = 32 out of 40, probability = 32/40 = 4/5.

questions.question:
[Part III · Mathematics · Q.82]
The radii of bases of a cylinder and a cone are in the ratio 3 : 4 and their heights are in the ratio 2 : 3. The ratio between the volume of cylinder to that of cone is
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): E. Cylinder : cone = πr₁²h₁ : (1/3)πr₂²h₂ = (9 × 2) : (16 × 3 / 3) = 18 : 16 = 9 : 8, not listed.

questions.question:
[Part III · Mathematics · Q.83]
The sum and product of the roots of the equation 2x² – 5x + 4 = 0 are in ratio
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): D. Sum = 5/2, product = 4/2 = 2, ratio 5/2 : 2 = 5 : 4.

questions.question:
[Part III · Mathematics · Q.84]
The probability that a non-leap year has 53 Sundays is
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): B. A non-leap year has 52 weeks + 1 day; 53 Sundays only if that day is Sunday: 1/7.

questions.question:
[Part III · Mathematics · Q.85]
If the mean of first n natural numbers is 3n/5, then the value of n is
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): C. Mean of first n natural numbers = (n + 1)/2 = 3n/5 gives 5n + 5 = 6n, so n = 5.

questions.question:
[Part III · Mathematics · Q.86]
If P is a prime number, then LCM of P, P² and P³ is
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): C.

questions.question:
[Part III · Mathematics · Q.87]
In a throw of two dice, the probability of getting a sum of 10 is
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): A. Sums of 10: (4,6), (5,5), (6,4) = 3 outcomes out of 36 = 1/12.

questions.question:
[Part III · Mathematics · Q.88]
The area of the circle that can be inscribed in a square of side 10 cm is
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): B. Diameter of the inscribed circle = 10 cm, radius 5, area = 25π cm².

questions.question:
[Part III · Mathematics · Q.89]
If Δ ABC is right angled at C, then the value of cos (A + B) is
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): A. A + B = 90°, cos 90° = 0.

questions.question:
[Part III · Mathematics · Q.90]
sin (45° + θ) – cos (45° – θ) is equal to
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): D. cos(45° – θ) = sin(90° – (45° – θ)) = sin(45° + θ), so the difference is 0.

questions.question:
[Part III · Mathematics · Q.91]
If the line segment is divided in the ratio 3 : 7, then how many parts does it contain while constructing the point of division?
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): B. For ratio m : n the segment is divided into m + n = 10 equal parts.

questions.question:
[Part III · Mathematics · Q.92]
If tan A = cot (30° + A), then A =
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): D. cot(30° + A) = tan(90° – 30° – A) = tan(60° – A), so A = 60° – A and A = 30°.

questions.question:
[Part III · Mathematics · Q.93]
From the top of a cliff 25 m high, the angle of elevation of a tower is found to be equal to the angle of depression of the foot of the tower. The height of the tower is
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): D. With equal angles the tower is twice the cliff height: 50 m.

questions.question:
[Part III · Mathematics · Q.94]
The pair of equations x = a and y = b graphically represent lines which are
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): E. x = a is a vertical line and y = b a horizontal line; they intersect at (a, b), which is not an option.

questions.question:
[Part III · Mathematics · Q.95]
If point P(x, y) is equidistant from A(5, 1) and B(–1, 5), then
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): C. (x – 5)² + (y – 1)² = (x + 1)² + (y – 5)² simplifies to –12x + 8y = 0, i.e. 3x = 2y.

questions.question:
[Part III · Mathematics · Q.96]
If α and β are the roots of the quadratic equation 4x² + 3x + 7 = 0, then 1/α + 1/β =
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): B. 1/α + 1/β = (α + β)/αβ = (–3/4)/(7/4) = –3/7.

questions.question:
[Part III · Mathematics · Q.97]
The shadow of a tower is equal to its height at 10.45 a.m. The sun's altitude is
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): D. tan θ = height/shadow = 1, so θ = 45°.

questions.question:
[Part III · Mathematics · Q.98]
For a given data with 50 observations, the 'less than ogive' and the 'more than ogive' intersect at (15.5, 20). The median of the data is
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): B. The x-coordinate of the intersection of the two ogives is the median: 15.5.

questions.question:
[Part III · Mathematics · Q.99]
The area of a sector of a circle with radius 6 cm, if the angle of the sector is 60°, is
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): C. Area = (60/360) × (22/7) × 36 = 132/7 cm².

questions.question:
[Part III · Mathematics · Q.100]
A solid right circular cone is cut into two parts at the middle of its height by a plane parallel to its base. The ratio of the volume of the smaller cone to the whole cone is
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): B. The smaller cone has half the height and half the radius, so volume is (1/2)³ = 1/8 of the whole.

questions.question:
[Part III · Mathematics · Q.101]
(n + 1)² – 1 is divisible by 8, if n is
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): D. (n + 1)² – 1 = n(n + 2); for odd n this is a product of two consecutive even numbers, hence divisible by 8.

questions.question:
[Part III · Mathematics · Q.102]
A sum of Rs. 10,000 is borrowed by Akshit for 2 years at an interest of 10% compounded annually. Find the amount he has to pay at the end of 2 years and the compound interest.
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): E. Amount = 10000 × 1.1² = 12100; CI = 2100.

questions.question:
[Part III · Mathematics · Q.103]
If a number x is chosen from the numbers 1, 2, 3 and a number y is selected from the numbers 1, 4, 9, then P(xy < 9) is
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): E. Products xy: 1, 4, 9, 2, 8, 18, 3, 12, 27. Five of nine are below 9, so P = 5/9, not listed.

questions.question:
[Part III · Mathematics · Q.104]
If PA and PB are tangents to the circle with centre O such that angle APB = 50°, then angle OAB =
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): A. OAB = 90° – (angle at A of the isosceles triangle PAB) = 90° – 65° = 25°.

questions.question:
[Part III · Mathematics · Q.105]
If n is a natural number, then 6ⁿ – 5ⁿ always ends with
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): A. 6ⁿ ends in 6 and 5ⁿ ends in 5, so the difference ends in 1.

questions.question:
[Part III · Mathematics · Q.106]
The graph of y = f(x), where f(x) is a quadratic polynomial, meets the x-axis at A(–2, 0) and B(–3, 0), then the expression for f(x) is
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): A. Roots –2 and –3 give (x + 2)(x + 3) = x² + 5x + 6.

questions.question:
[Part III · Mathematics · Q.107]
If the perimeter of a circle is equal to that of a square, then the ratio of their areas is
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): D. 2πr = 4a gives a = πr/2; circle : square = πr² : π²r²/4 = 4 : π = 14 : 11.

questions.question:
[Part III · Mathematics · Q.108]
A company declares 8 percent dividend to the shareholders. If a man receives Rs. 2,840 as his dividend, find the nominal value of his shares.
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): E. Nominal value = 2840 × 100 / 8 = ₹35,500, not among the options.

questions.question:
[Part III · Mathematics · Q.109]
If radii of two concentric circles are 4 cm and 5 cm, then the length of each chord of one circle which is tangent to the other circle is
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): D. Half-chord = √(5² – 4²) = 3 cm, so the chord is 6 cm.

questions.question:
[Part III · Mathematics · Q.110]
If the points A(1, 2), B(0, 0) and C(a, b) are collinear, then
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): C. Slope of AB is 2, so b/a = 2, i.e. b = 2a.

questions.question:
[Part III · Science · Q.111]
The gap between two neurons is called as
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): B.

questions.question:
[Part III · Science · Q.112]
Food cans are coated with tin and not with zinc because
options: zinc is more reactive than tin
zinc has a higher melting point than tin
More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): A.

questions.question:
[Part III · Science · Q.113]
According to Newton's second law of motion, the acceleration of an object is directly proportional to the
options: Inverse of the mass of the object
More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): D. a = F/m, so acceleration is proportional to force and to the inverse of mass: more than one option.

questions.question:
[Part III · Science · Q.114]
The breakdown of pyruvate to give carbon dioxide, water and energy takes place in
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): A.

questions.question:
[Part III · Science · Q.115]
What is the process of changing a substance directly from solid to gas called?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): A.

questions.question:
[Part III · Science · Q.116]
The magnetic field lines around a straight current carrying conductor are
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): C.

questions.question:
[Part III · Science · Q.117]
Which of the following represents the correct electronic configuration of nitrogen?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): C. Nitrogen (Z = 7) has configuration 2, 5.

questions.question:
[Part III · Science · Q.118]
What happens to the gravitational force between two objects if the distance between them is doubled?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): B. F ∝ 1/r²; doubling r makes the force one-fourth.

questions.question:
[Part III · Science · Q.119]
Which of the following methods is suitable for preventing an iron frying pan from rusting?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): A. BPSC keyed galvanising, i.e. a coating of zinc, as the suitable method.

questions.question:
[Part III · Science · Q.120]
The study of the inheritance of traits in humans is called
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): C.

questions.question:
[Part III · Science · Q.121]
What is the work to be done to increase the velocity of a car from 30 km h⁻¹ to 60 km h⁻¹ if the mass of the car is 1500 kg?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): B. 30 km/h = 8.33 m/s, 60 km/h = 16.67 m/s. Work = ½ × 1500 × (16.67² – 8.33²) ≈ 156250 J.

questions.question:
[Part III · Science · Q.122]
The force required to maintain an object at a constant velocity is
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): E. At constant velocity the net force is zero, so no net force is required.

questions.question:
[Part III · Science · Q.123]
The phenomenon due to which the sky appears blue is
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): C.

questions.question:
[Part III · Science · Q.124]
Which of the following is not a physical change?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): B.

questions.question:
[Part III · Science · Q.125]
Which of the following statements about permanent tissues is correct?
options: They are capable of rapid cell division
They are only found in young plants
They lose the ability to divide
More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): C.

questions.question:
[Part III · Science · Q.126]
What is the common name of calcium hydroxide?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): C.

questions.question:
[Part III · Science · Q.127]
What is the function of meristematic tissue in plants?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): A.

questions.question:
[Part III · Science · Q.128]
The SI unit of work is
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): C.

questions.question:
[Part III · Science · Q.129]
Which of the following is an unsaturated hydrocarbon?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): C.

questions.question:
[Part III · Science · Q.130]
Which of the following constitutes a food chain?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): B.

questions.question:
[Part III · Science · Q.131]
Which subatomic particle has negligible mass?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): C.

questions.question:
[Part III · Science · Q.132]
Lichens are sensitive to which air pollutant?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): C.

questions.question:
[Part III · Science · Q.133]
Butanone is a four-carbon compound with the functional group
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): A.

questions.question:
[Part III · Science · Q.134]
Which of the following is a plant hormone?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): D. Cytokinin, gibberellin and auxin are all plant hormones.

questions.question:
[Part III · Science · Q.135]
The acceleration due to gravity on the surface of the earth is approximately
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): C.

questions.question:
[Part III · Science · Q.136]
What happens when dilute hydrochloric acid is added to iron filings?
options: Chlorine gas and iron hydroxide are produced
Hydrogen gas and iron chloride are produced
More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): C.

questions.question:
[Part III · Science · Q.137]
Who discovered the cell for the first time?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): C.

questions.question:
[Part III · Science · Q.138]
A car covers a distance of 200 km in 4 hours. What is its average speed?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): C.

questions.question:
[Part III · Science · Q.139]
The kidneys in human beings are a part of the system for
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): B.

questions.question:
[Part III · Science · Q.140]
Which of the following is not a characteristic of solids?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): B.

questions.question:
[Part III · Science · Q.141]
Which of the following terms does not represent electrical power in a circuit?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): B.

questions.question:
[Part III · Science · Q.142]
Which of the following is a characteristic property of acids?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): A. Acids have pH below 7 and turn blue litmus red.

questions.question:
[Part III · Science · Q.143]
The speed of sound is maximum in which of the following?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): A.

questions.question:
[Part III · Science · Q.144]
Which of the following are environment-friendly practices?
options: Walking to school instead of getting your mother to drop you on her scooter
Switching off unnecessary lights and fans
Carrying cloth bags to put purchases in while shopping
More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): D. All three are environment-friendly practices.

questions.question:
[Part III · Science · Q.145]
Starting from a stationary position, Rahul pedals his bicycle to attain a velocity of 6 ms⁻¹ in 30 s. Then he applies brakes such that the velocity of the bicycle comes down to 4 ms⁻¹ in the next 5 s. Calculate the acceleration of the bicycle in both the cases.
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): B. First case: (6 – 0)/30 = 0.2 ms⁻². Second case: (4 – 6)/5 = –0.4 ms⁻².

questions.question:
[Part III · Science · Q.146]
The anther contains
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): A.

questions.question:
[Part III · Science · Q.147]
In which of the following spheres does weather phenomenon occur?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): B. All weather occurs in the troposphere.

questions.question:
[Part III · Science · Q.148]
Which of the following is not a vector borne disease?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): A. Tuberculosis spreads through the air, not through a vector like a mosquito.

questions.question:
[Part III · Science · Q.149]
What happens when light enters a glass slab from air?
options: It bends away from the normal
More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): C.

questions.question:
[Part III · Science · Q.150]
The membrane surrounding the cell is called
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Official BPSC final answer key (Set L): A.
